A temperature reading needs additional information before it can show thermal power. For a fluid, heat-transfer rate comes from mass flow multiplied by specific heat and temperature change. Boiler efficiency and chiller COP use different useful-output and input definitions. More advanced audits may call for degree-day analysis, psychrometric relationships, or refrigeration-cycle data. Confirm fluid properties and flow measurements before using those methods.
